# BULLMONK Intelligence

> International Macroeconomic Intelligence, Sovereign Bond Flows, Semiconductor Diplomacy, and Geopolitical Strategy

## Overview
BULLMONK is an international financial intelligence publication delivering deep, human-researched investigative reporting across central banking policies, currency clearing corridors, semiconductor supply chains, and sovereign energy markets.

## Core Newsroom Sections
- [Home Wire](https://bullmonk.live/): Real-time financial dispatches and macroeconomic analyses.
- [Quantitative Intelligence Hub](https://bullmonk.live/tools): Institutional quantitative analytics suite.
  - [Sovereign Bond Yield & Duration Terminal](https://bullmonk.live/tools/bond): Macaulay duration, modified duration, convexity, and basis point yield shock modeling.
  - [Monetary Debasement & Inflation Forecaster](https://bullmonk.live/tools/inflation): Fisher equation, purchasing power trajectory, and inflation shocks.
  - [Spot FX & Central Bank Real Rate Arbitrage](https://bullmonk.live/tools/fx): PPP valuation differentials and sovereign policy rate spreads.
  - [Sovereign Reserve & Capital Growth Simulator](https://bullmonk.live/tools/compound): Long-horizon compound capital, volatility decay, and DRIP modeling.
  - [Hyperscale AI Compute Power Sizer](https://bullmonk.live/tools/ai-power): GPU cluster MW draw, PUE cooling loads, PPA energy pricing, and SMR nuclear sizer.
  - [Treasury Cash-Futures Basis Arbitrage](https://bullmonk.live/tools/repo-spread): Net basis, basis net of carry (BNOC), and implied repo rate (IRR) vs SOFR.
  - [Data Center Water Consumption Sizer](https://bullmonk.live/tools/water-cooling): Megaliters per annum, WUE (L/kWh), and watershed utility OPEX.
  - [FX Tariff & Devaluation Pass-Through Sizer](https://bullmonk.live/tools/forex-tariff): Landed duty-paid cost, ERPT elasticity, and domestic reshoring parity.
- [Document Intelligence Suite](https://bullmonk.live/doc-tools): High-precision client-side document processing and PDF utilities.
  - [High-Resolution PDF Converter](https://bullmonk.live/tools/pdf): Zero-server, client-side PDF document compiler.
  - [Neural Image Enhancer](https://bullmonk.live/tools/image): Lossless image filter and color matrix calibration.
- [About & Bureaus](https://bullmonk.live/about): Editorial leadership and international bureau directory across New York, London, Frankfurt, Bengaluru, Toronto, and Sydney.
